cohort: All three first-rank TypeScript programs in the paired compiler cohort; no validity-label filtering.
guards: Every new error lies in a standalone standard equality assertion.
Removed assertion operands contain no explicit call or assignment.
Input edits cannot overlap removed assertions.
At least one nonconstant observation remains.
Fresh complete-program review, enabled high reasoning, before native execution.
limits: Property reads may invoke getters. This is not an equivalence proof.
Compiler acceptance is counterevidence against setup errors, not proof of semantic validity.
This three-program component cannot establish detector recall.
tests: Three tests passed: retained input/actions, action-error refusal, stale source receipt refusal.
